# enlace

> Serve all your web apps from a single process — they don't import it, they don't know it's there


## Pages in this subsection

- [enlace](enlace.html.md): enlace – Compose, serve, and deploy multiple web apps from a single codebase.
- [enlace.access](enlace.access.html.md): Who may reach an app: the one predicate the gate and the launcher both call.
- [enlace.analytics](enlace.analytics.html.md): Privacy-first page-view analytics, turned on per app.
- [enlace.app_icons](enlace.app_icons.html.md): One icon per app, served in every form a browser or phone asks for.
- [enlace.appmeta](enlace.appmeta.html.md): App metadata: harvest, resolve, and render titles / descriptions / keywords / icons.
- [enlace.base](enlace.base.html.md): Core data structures for enlace platform configuration.
- [enlace.build](enlace.build.html.md): Run and validate declarative app builds from &#96;app.toml&#96; &#96;&#91;build&#93;&#96;.
- [enlace.compose](enlace.compose.html.md): ASGI app composition for enlace.
- [enlace.diagnose](enlace.diagnose.html.md): Diagnose app compatibility with enlace.
- [enlace.discover](enlace.discover.html.md): Convention-based app discovery for enlace.
- [enlace.doctor](enlace.doctor.html.md): Post-deploy smoke checks for a running enlace gateway.
- [enlace.frontend](enlace.frontend.html.md): SPA-aware static file serving for enlace.
- [enlace.gzip_selective](enlace.gzip_selective.html.md): Compression that knows what it must not compress.
- [enlace.html_rewrite](enlace.html_rewrite.html.md): Rewrite HTML response bodies from pure-ASGI middleware.
- [enlace.manifest](enlace.manifest.html.md): Deploy manifest: build-identity for diagnosing “what is actually deployed”.
- [enlace.proxy](enlace.proxy.html.md): Lightweight ASGI reverse proxy for process and external backends.
- [enlace.strategies](enlace.strategies.html.md): Backend-strategy registry and built-in strategies for enlace.
- [enlace.supervise](enlace.supervise.html.md): Dev-mode process supervisor for enlace.
- [enlace.util](enlace.util.html.md): Internal helpers for enlace.
